'''Opal earrings''' are [[jewelry]] that help the wearer underwater. Worn in the head slot, they give {{MCW|Dolphin's Grace}} and, while the wearer is in water, {{MCW|Conduit Power}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
The [[Jeweler]] sells opal earrings at Novice level for 4 [[Obol]]s and one [[Opal]]. The trade can be used 999 times.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/1/opal_earrings.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Effect ===
While worn by a player, opal earrings give Dolphin's Grace at all times, and Conduit Power whenever the player is in water. Both effects are hidden and reapplied every tick for 1 second, so they wear off within a second of the earrings being removed or, for Conduit Power, of the player leaving the water.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/conduit_power.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/conduit_power.json}}</ref> Conduit Power lets the player breathe underwater, see better underwater and mine faster there, as in vanilla. Dolphin's Grace only has an effect while swimming.

=== Armor ===
Opal earrings are worn in the head slot and take the place of a helmet. They give 1 [[armor]] point and no armor toughness or knockback resistance. Like all jewelry, they are unbreakable and, being built on a netherite helmet, don't burn in fire or lava. See [[Jewelry]].
